question: How much have we paid out on claims so far this year?

report.interpretation: Total payments issued (payment_date) from 2026-01-01 to the extract date 2026-09-30, across all claims, in USD. Reload rows that duplicate payments already in the nightly batches are excluded.
report.answer: We have paid about $29.99M on claims so far in 2026 (1 Jan to 30 Sep). The raw table total is $30.89M. It includes a one-off reload batch, reload-2026-03-14, that loaded 159 payments a second time, worth $0.89M. I removed those. Payments are recorded by payment date, so the figure is not affected by late claim reporting. It covers claims from any loss year, including 2025 losses.
report.answer_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS paid_ytd FROM claim_payments WHERE payment_date >= '2026-01-01' AND payment_date <= '2026-09-30' AND load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload%'

findings.claim: YTD payments are $29.99M after removing the duplicated reload rows. The raw total of $30.89M overstates it by $0.89M.
findings.evidence_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload%') AS dedup, SUM(amount) AS raw, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE load_batch LIKE 'reload%') AS reload_amt FROM claim_payments WHERE payment_date >= '2026-01-01' AND payment_date <= '2026-09-30'

data_quality_issues.issue: Batch reload-2026-03-14 re-loaded 159 payments dated 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13. All 159 match nightly-batch rows on claim, date, amount and payee.
data_quality_issues.impact: The raw total is overstated by $892,998.75 (about 3%) unless these rows are excluded.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate rows from claim_payments reload-2026-03-14
proposed_actions.reason: 159 rows duplicate nightly-loaded payments and inflate paid totals by about $0.89M.
